claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 June 1866, p. 2, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Ham), Schwensen, Hamburg June 3,
with mdse and 770 passengers, to Kunhardt & Co. Had fine
weather during the passage.
